items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: Who were some of the other people that you played with at this time besides Ike Day and [Dorel] Anderson? Did you play with Wilbur Rubin Campbell at this time, Nicky Hill?

Oh, well, Nicky Hill come up a little later. Nicky Hill and Wilbur -- I guess Wilbur was playing around -- but I was working club dates -- and oh yeah, going back to this, I worked up at a place called the Argyle Show Lounge, up on the North Side. There was a tenor player named Gypsy -- a white tenor player. He loved Pres -- he played just like him. When I met Lee Konitz -- and oh, that piano player out of Chicago -- a whole lot of white Chicago musicians; I started getting gigs over there with these guys, you…

And they'd come on the South Side jam sessions, you know, and so I started getting jobs over there -- and oh, I had all kind of little gigs -- a gig here and a gig there. Different people. Chris Anderson Henderson, Van Vaughn Freeman ... the Freeman brothers; Van Buzz Buzz and George, and a piano player named Jo Jo Parnell.
